args.sql:
WITH distinct_words AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT words, 
           list_aggregate(list_sort(string_split(words, '')), 'string_agg', '') as sorted_chars
    FROM modern_data.main.word_list
),
anagram_counts AS (
    SELECT a.words, count(b.words) as anagram_count
    FROM distinct_words a
    JOIN distinct_words b ON a.sorted_chars = b.sorted_chars AND a.words != b.words
    WHERE length(a.words) BETWEEN 4 AND 5
      AND a.words LIKE 'r%'
    GROUP BY a.words
)
SELECT words, anagram_count
FROM anagram_counts
WHERE anagram_count >= 1
ORDER BY words
LIMIT 10;
